coordinates.note: REVIEW REQUIRED (A17), after real effort: no CERN geodetic/survey publication giving WGS84 coordinates for the SND@LHC/TI18 tunnel location was found in this session (home.cern and the INSPIRE experiment record state only the distance/direction from ATLAS IP1, not coordinates; a Nominatim/OpenStreetMap search for the tunnel name returned only generic CERN-campus results, not a point specific to this tunnel). SND@LHC is sited in the TI18 tunnel on the opposite side of ATLAS interaction point 1 from FASER's TI12, at a comparable ~480 m distance (general knowledge of the FASER/SND@LHC forward-physics programme; the INSPIRE experiment record fetched for SND@LHC in this session gives its pseudo-rapidity coverage but does not itself restate the TI18/480 m fact in the description text captured). As a placeholder, this record reuses the numeric coordinate value already sourced for site:cern-point-1-atlas (46.2355606, 6.0546968), the nearest existing sourced CERN point, since the detector is only ~480 m from that point -- well inside this record's widened precision_m. kind is kept as 'detector' (not 'campus') because the structural validator requires kind in [detector, underground_lab] for any site holding a detector placement; confidence is 'uncertain' and this note flags the value for geographic review, exactly as site:cern-point-1-atlas and site:cern-point-8-lhcb do.
coordinates.quote: 80 hectares in the Swiss communes of Meyrin and Satigny and the French communes of Prevessin-Moens and Saint-Genis-Pouilly.

name: TI18 tunnel (SND@LHC)
notes: TI18 is a former LEP-era transfer tunnel on the opposite side of ATLAS interaction point 1 from FASER's TI12; now houses the SND@LHC detector.

The official SND@LHC site (attempted at sndlhc.web.cern.ch and sndlhc.cern) could not be resolved/fetched in this session (DNS lookup failure in this environment); only the INSPIRE experiment record was used.

REVIEW REQUIRED (A17): coordinate is a reused neighbouring-point placeholder (kind: detector, confidence: uncertain); see coordinates.note. The TI18/480 m siting fact itself is not independently sourced in this session to the same standard as FASER's TI12/480m fact and should be re-verified against an official SND@LHC or CERN source.
country/place set to CH to match the reused anchor point (site:cern-point-1-atlas, Meyrin CH); the true tunnel geography for TI18 was not independently confirmed in this session.

summary.plain: An unused service tunnel at CERN, on the opposite side of the ATLAS collision point from FASER, that houses the SND@LHC experiment, which studies neutrinos and searches for rare particles produced in LHC collisions.
summary.technical: TI18, a former LEP transfer tunnel near LHC interaction point 1, on the opposite side from FASER's TI12; houses the SND@LHC detector.
